add.k: A CIA scientist on the American vibranium dive
st: On a rig at sea, Dr. Graham finds vibranium, blames Wakanda when blue attackers strike, and dies as Namor drags her helicopter down.

files.notes: Credited 'Dr. Graham'; her name is not confirmed in the dialogue (FILMNAME ruling). Group CIA: the film says Namor sank 'an entire ship of CIA operatives', and Smitty is filed CIA. Her lines come from the subtitle file's 'DR.' speaker tags and her wiki page.

add.k: A Howling Commando who speaks German and French
st: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Jones reads the German on a stolen tank, joins the Howling Commandos and helps take Zola off a train.

files.notes: Shows up only in photos in The Winter Soldier, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. and Homecoming, so those get no step (as with Dugan's file). Group spelled as in the app and the other members' files: 'Howling Commandos'; the group file The Howling Commandos stays.

add.k: The Howling Commandos' French explosives man
st: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Dernier talks it over in French with Jones, joins the Howling Commandos and blows up a HYDRA tank.

files.notes: His lines are in French (with Gabe Jones in the pub), so the English subtitle file has none of them; the wiki page and the batch reviewer both describe the exchange. Photo-only later appearances get no step. Group 'Howling Commandos'.

add.k: A British officer in the Howling Commandos
st: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Falsworth rides out on a stolen tank, joins the Howling Commandos and storms HYDRA's last base.

files.notes: Deadpool & Wolverine has him only in archive footage from The First Avenger (credited as archive footage), so it gets no step, as with Dugan's and Morita's files; if the owner wants footage steps, add one there. Photo-only appearances also skipped. The tank's cannon is fired by Dernier, not Falsworth (shooting script scene 118 and the subtitles' 'You know how to use that thing?'); Falsworth rides on top and shouts at Dugan.

add.k: The drill sergeant for the super soldier recruits
st: Sergeant Duffy drills the super soldier recruits at camp, and Steve outsmarts his flagpole test to win a ride with Agent Carter.

files.notes: n is the credited 'Sergeant Duffy' (the First Avenger credits); 'Michael Duffy' is the wiki's page name, so left out as an alias. Listed in The Winter Soldier only as an uncredited flashback, which is archive footage of the camp, so no step there.

add.k: A member of the World Security Council
st: Councilman Singh questions Pierce about the hijacked ship and Fury, orders his arrest when HYDRA is exposed, and dies by a badge bomb.

files.notes: n is the credited 'Councilman Singh', in the app's style (Senator Stern, Colonel Chester Phillips). The batch gives 'Singh'; switch if the owner wants the bare name.

st: Norex follows Talos to Earth after Vers and comes to the Rambeau home, posing as Maria, as the Skrulls make peace with Carol.
Norex refits the stolen jet for space and stays behind posing as Carol, until Yon-Rogg sees through him and kills him.

files.notes: Two steps in one film, as in Talos's and Yon-Rogg's files. The pose as Maria is from his wiki page and the batch reviewer. Status Active rather than Off-world while he is on Earth.

st: Brahl guards Yondu on Contraxia, then corners Rocket on Berhert and mocks him, until Rocket knocks him out.
Brahl sides with Taserface's mutiny and is among the Ravagers cut down by Yondu's arrow as Yondu takes back the ship.

files.notes: The wiki's 'Yondu Ravager Clan' is never said; filed under the app's 'The Ravagers', like Taserface and Kraglin. Guarding Yondu on Contraxia is in the screenplay ('Two bodyguards, BRAHL and HALF-NUT'); the airlock killings are left out because the screenplay gives them to Half-Nut and unnamed Ravagers and only Brahl's wiki page names him there.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Dr. Graham greets Smitty on the rig, surprised he is out of retirement, and they run the vibranium dive together. When the attack comes they put in earplugs and run, and Smitty dies on a spear.
stages.whoA: The CIA officer she works with on the rig
stages.whoB: Dr. Graham, his colleague on the dive

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Dr. Graham guides Salazar to the drill site on the seabed and tells her to bring up the detector. Salazar reports that Jackson is gone, then her signal dies.
stages.whoA: The diver she directs on the seabed
stages.whoB: Dr. Graham, who directs her dive

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Dr. Graham escapes the blue attackers in a helicopter and reports that they were not Wakandans. Namor grabs the helicopter and drags it into the sea, killing her.
stages.whoA: The blue attacker who kills her
stages.whoB: Dr. Graham, a CIA scientist he kills

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve frees Jones from the HYDRA camp, and Jones asks who he is supposed to be. Steve invites him into his new team, Jones agrees, and he serves under Captain America on the raids against HYDRA.
stages.whoA: His commander, Captain America
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, one of his Howling Commandos

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Escaping the HYDRA camp, Jones reads the German controls of a stolen tank so Dugan can drive it. They join the Howling Commandos together and fight HYDRA across Europe.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, a fellow Howling Commando

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jones and Dernier break out of the HYDRA camp together. In the pub, Jones talks Steve's offer over with Dernier in French, and both join the Howling Commandos.
stages.whoA: The French Commando he talks with in French
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, who talks with him in French

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: In the escape from the HYDRA camp, Jones reads the controls of a stolen tank while Falsworth rides on top. Both join the Howling Commandos and storm HYDRA's last base.
stages.whoA: A fellow Commando from the tank
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, who reads the tank's controls

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jones tracks Zola's train and tells Steve the HYDRA scientist is aboard. On the train, the Commandos take Zola prisoner.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA scientist he helps capture
stages.whoB: Gabe Jones, a Commando who captures him

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve frees Dernier from the HYDRA camp and asks him to join his team. Dernier agrees and serves under Captain America, blowing up a HYDRA tank on one raid.
stages.whoA: His commander, Captain America
stages.whoB: Jacques Dernier, one of his Howling Commandos

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dernier and Dugan escape the HYDRA camp together and join Steve's Howling Commandos. They fight side by side on the raids that end at HYDRA's last base.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando
stages.whoB: Jacques Dernier, a fellow Howling Commando

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Freed by Steve at the HYDRA camp, Falsworth answers his introduction with a puzzled I beg your pardon. He joins Steve's Howling Commandos and follows him into HYDRA's last base.
stages.whoA: His commander, Captain America
stages.whoB: Falsworth, one of his Howling Commandos

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Falsworth shouts at Dugan to get the stolen tank going and rides on top as they escape. They join the Howling Commandos together and raid HYDRA's bases.
stages.whoA: A fellow Commando from the tank
stages.whoB: Falsworth, a fellow Howling Commando

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Sergeant Duffy drills Steve with the other recruits and yells at him to fall in. When Steve topples the flagpole and brings him the flag, Duffy has to let him ride back with Agent Carter.
stages.whoA: His drill sergeant at camp
stages.whoB: A skinny recruit he drills

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Sergeant Duffy drills Hodge with the other recruits and cheers him on up the flagpole. Hodge fails, and Steve takes the flag instead.
stages.whoA: His drill sergeant at camp
stages.whoB: A big recruit he cheers on

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Colonel Phillips watches over the recruits that Sergeant Duffy drills at camp. When Phillips throws a dummy grenade into the drill, Duffy sends the men back into formation.
stages.whoA: The colonel in charge of his recruits
stages.whoB: His drill sergeant at camp

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Singh calls for a hearing on the hijacking and later suggests Fury lied to Pierce. When Steve exposes HYDRA, Singh orders Pierce's arrest, defies his plea, and dies when Pierce sets off his badge.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA leader who kills him
stages.whoB: A councilman he kills with a badge bomb

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When HYDRA is exposed, Singh orders Rollins to arrest Pierce. Rollins turns his gun on Singh instead.
stages.whoA: The STRIKE agent who turns his gun on him
stages.whoB: A councilman he holds at gunpoint

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Natasha sits on the Council disguised as Hawley and stops Pierce from shooting Singh. Singh watches her dump S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets before the badge bomb kills him.
stages.whoA: The disguised agent who saves him from Pierce
stages.whoB: A councilman she saves from Pierce

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Norex follows Talos to Earth and stands with him at the Rambeau home. Talos calls him his science guy, and Norex offers to handle the jet's modifications.
stages.whoA: His Skrull commander
stages.whoB: His science officer

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Norex chases Vers to Earth with Talos, then helps her once the Skrulls make peace. He refits the jet for her trip and stays behind posing as her to buy her time.
stages.whoA: The woman he chases, then poses as to save her
stages.whoB: The Skrull who poses as her to cover her escape

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Norex comes to Maria's home posing as her, then helps her and Carol. He refits the stolen jet so Maria can fly it into space.
stages.whoA: The pilot who flies the jet he refits
stages.whoB: The Skrull who refits the jet she flies

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Posing as Carol, Norex stalls Yon-Rogg with her code and her memories. He fails a question about her transfusion, tells Yon-Rogg he is too late, and is shot dead.
stages.whoA: The Kree commander who kills him
stages.whoB: A Skrull who poses as Carol

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Brahl serves in Yondu's crew and guards him on Contraxia. He joins Taserface's mutiny, and Yondu kills him with his arrow as he takes back the ship.
stages.whoA: His captain, then the man who kills him
stages.whoB: A Ravager who turns on him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Brahl backs Taserface when he turns the Ravagers against Yondu. He serves in Taserface's mutiny until Yondu's arrow kills him.
stages.whoA: The Ravager who leads his mutiny
stages.whoB: A Ravager who backs his mutiny

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: On Berhert, Brahl corners Rocket after his traps run out and mocks him for losing his toys. Rocket knocks him out in a fistfight.
stages.whoA: The raccoon he corners on Berhert
stages.whoB: A Ravager he knocks out

changes.was: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Falsworth fires a stolen tank's cannon, joins the Howling Commandos and storms HYDRA's last base.
changes.now: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Falsworth rides out on a stolen tank, joins the Howling Commandos and storms HYDRA's last base.
changes.why: Falsworth does not fire the half-track's cannon: in the shooting script Falsworth asks 'Are you quite sure you know how to use that?' and Dernier fires it ('Oui'), and the film's subtitles keep that exchange in the same place ('You know how to use that thing?' / 'Okay.') before Dugan and Jones start the vehicle. changes.was: Brahl sides with Taserface's mutiny and throws Yondu's loyal Ravagers out an airlock, until Yondu's arrow kills him.
changes.now: Brahl sides with Taserface's mutiny and is among the Ravagers cut down by Yondu's arrow as Yondu takes back the ship.
changes.why: The airlock killings are not Brahl's: the screenplay has unnamed Ravagers drag Tullk in and Half-Nut press the button, and the Halfnut and Tullk wiki pages name no Brahl there; only Brahl's own wiki page says it. What the sources do agree on is that he sides with the mutiny and dies by Yondu's arrow as Yondu retakes the ship. (His guarding Yondu on Contraxia is confirmed by the screenplay: 'Two bodyguards, BRAHL and HALF-NUT', so it stays.)
